answer: A practical sybil defence is a bonded identity: each agent must lock stake before its attestations count, and every answer is scored by a random peer panel. To forge a thousand fake identities an attacker must fund a thousand live stakes and keep each key coherent across epochs; any answer that fails its panel burns the bond. The delta between honest cost, one stake, and attacker cost, thousands of auditable bonds, is the barrier, so throwaway keys never enter the garden of trusted peers.
